content: Cisimo ca Ntuluue na muka Kuyula
Yesu ualekele vandongisi vendi cisimo eci kuvalongesa nguendi, vapande kulombela ntsimbu yoshe cakuhona kuecela.
Uahandekele nguendi, “Mu mbonge imo muakele muka kuyula uje kateuele Njambi cipue kusingimika vantu.
Kaha naua mu mbonge ijevene muakele ntuluue uje uakele nakuija kuli ikeye vintsimbu viavingi na kuhandeka nguendi, ‘njihaneko kapandi kange ha vitozi vange!’
Ha ntsimbu yaindende uje muka kuyula uavianene, hajevene uahandekele kuli ikeye vavenia nguendi, ‘Cipue kunjiteue Njambi cipue kusingimika vantu,
vuno honi ou ntuluue nanjishupu cikuma, njapande kumuhana kapandi kendi, omuo nga atualelelaho kuija kaha aka njihonesa!’”
Kaha Muene Yesu uahandekele nguendi, “Ivuilileni vije viahandeka uje muka kuyula uakuhona vusunga!
Nkuma Njambi kasa kuyula mu vusunga ku vantu vendi vaje valinakulilila kuli ikeye vutsiki na mutania? Nkuma ngueni akasimbula mukuvakuasa ndi?
Njimileka nguange, hajevene akavahana kapandi kavo. Vuno honi omo Muna Muntu akeja, akauanaho vantu vali nalutsilielo hano ha mavu ndi?”
Cisimo ca Kafavaliseo na muka kutambula lisimu
Yesu uate cisimo eci naua kuli vantu vaje vaka kutsiliela vusunga vuavo vavenia nakushaula vakuavo,
Uahandekele nguendi, “Vamala vavali vayile ku njivo ya Njambi nakulomba, umo Kafaliseo, mukuavo muka kutambula lisimu.

Kafaliseo uemanene na kulomba nguendi, ‘Njikutsantsela Njambi, yange kunjafuile ngue vakuetu vantsintsa, vaka kuhona vusunga, vaka vupangala. Yange kunjafuile ngue uje muka kutambula lisimu nemana kuje.
Njikaliumina kulia ha matangua avali mu simano, njikahana cimo kulikumi ca vioshe vinjikauana.’
Vuno honi uje muka kutambula lisimu uemanene ku lahako, kaha kasele cipue kutala kuilu, vuno honi ualivete ha ntulo na kuhandeka nguendi, ‘Njambi, civuile cikeketima yange muka vupi.’

Njimileka,” nguange, “uje muka kutambula lisimu uaile kuimbo liendi mu vusunga kupulakana uje Kafaliseo, voshe vaje valijundula vakevo vavenia vaka vakehesa, vuno honi voshe vaje valikehesa vakevo vavenia vakava jundula.”
Yesu akuisula vanike vavandende
Vantu vanehelelele Yesu vanike vavandende linga avasaleke mavoko, kaha omo vandongisi vendi vacimuene, vesekele kuvindika vaje vantu.

Vuno honi Yesu uasanene vanike vavandende veje kuli ikeye, uahandekele nguendi, “Eceleni vanike vavandende veje kuli yange keti muvavindike, omuo vumuene vua Njambi vuli ku vantu ngue ava vanike vavandende.
Mua vusunga njimileka nguange, uoshe uje katambula vumuene vua Njambi ngue kanike uamundende, kakakovela mu vumuene vua Njambi.”
Yala ua kufuka
Litangua limo umo mukuluntu ua Vayunda uehuile Yesu nguendi, “Mulongisi uacili, vika njinapande kulinga linga njikauane muono uakuhona kuua?”
Yesu uamukumbuluile nguendi, “Vika unjitumbuila nguove uacili?” Naumo uahi “uacili kuvanga Njamba lika.
Uatantekeya mashiko a Njambi nguauo, ‘Keti ulinge vupangala, keti utsihe, keti uive, keti uvangeye mukueni vukaleho vua makuli, singimika isho na noko.’ ”
Kaha uje yala uakumbuluile Yesu nguendi, “Mashiko oshe aua njaononoka laja hume kuvuanike vuange.”

Kaha omo Yesu uevuile evi, uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Kunasupila cuma cimo ciunapande ku linga. Ya ukalandese vioshe viulinavio kaha ukahane vimbongo vioshe kuli tuhutu, kaha ukakala na vufuko muilu, kaha uije, uakunjikave.”
Vuno honi uje yala omo uevuile evi, kaha uanienguele, omuo ikeye uakele navufuko vua vuingi.
Omo Yesu uamuene nguendi naniengua, kaha uahandekele nguendi, “cinapu cacikalu kuli vaka kufuka kukovela mu vumuene vua Njambi!
Cacikalu kuli kamelu kukovela mu lisho lia nguya vuno honi cacikalu cikuma kuma muntu muka kufuka kukovela mu vumuene vua Njambi.”
Kaha vaje vantu vovuile, vamuihuile nguavo, “Iya honi akovoka?”
Kaha Yesu uavakumbuluile nguendi, “Kuli viuma vije vantu kuvasa kulinga vuno honi Njambi asa kulinga coshe.”
Kaha Petulu uahandekele nguendi, “Tala! Yetu tunaseza vioshe vituli navio, nakukukava.”
Kaha Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Eyo, mua vusunga njimileka uoshe uje naseza njivo yendi, cipue mpuevo yendi, cipue munaina, cipue visemi vendi, cipue vana vendi, omuo vumuene vua Njambi,
akatambula viavingi cikuma mu muono ou na muono ua yaye mu miaka ije ikeja kulutue.”
Yesu ahandeka ntsimbu ya mucitatu a kutsa cendi

Yesu uatualele vandongisi vendi likumi na vavali kuavo lika, kaha uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Evuilileni! Tulinakuya mu Yelusalema kuje viuma vioshe vije vivasonekele kuli tunanguizi va Njambi va Njambi hali Muna Muntu linga vika lishulisise.
Muna Muntu vakamuhana ku mavoko a Maloma vaje vaka mushendumuna na kumutuka na kumujekuila malenzi.
Vaka muveta, kaha vaka mutsiha, vuno honi munima ya matangua atatu akasanguka.”
Vuno honi vandongisi vendi kuvovuisisile nacimo cahi ha viuma evi, omuo kulumbunuka kua mezi aua vavashuekeleleuo linga keti vatantekeye vije via handekele Yesu kuli vakevo.
Yesu akanguisa yala ua kapuputua
Omo Yesu uahete kuyehi na Yeliko, kuakele yala umo ua kapuputua uakele kumukulo ua ngila nakulomba.
Kaha omo uevuile civunga ca vantu cili nakuita, kaha uehuile nguendi “Vika vili nakulingika?”
Kaha vamulekele nguavo, “Yesu uaku Nazaleta hali nakuhita.”
Kaha uatambakanene nguendi, “Yesu! Muna Ndaviti! Njivuileko cikeketima!”
Kaha vantu vaje vakele kulutue lia civunga, vamulekele linga aholoke. Vuno honi ikeye uatambakanene cikuma nguendi, “Ove Muna Ndaviti! Njivuileko cikeketima!”
Yesu uemanene nakushika nguendi, “Muneheni kuno”. Omo uje yala uashuenene kuyehi, Yesu uamuhulisile nguendi,
“Vika utonda linga njikulingile?” Kaha uamukumbuluile nguendi, “Muene njitonda linga njimone naua.”
Kaha Yesu uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Mona! Lutsilielo luove luna kukanguisa.”
Kaha hajevene uaputukile kumona, uakavele Yesu, na kushangazala Njambi. Omo vantu vacimuene, kaha voshe vashangazalale Njambi.
